description: Violates the declared-capability rule (verification-contract.md §6.2; Manifesto §7): a check declares category 'integrity'. The contract grants standards exactly two check categories — structural and lifecycle-conformity; integrity is owned by the artifact manifest contract (artifact-manifest.md §5), not standard content. The runtime invokes only declared capability; a check whose category the contract does not declare is undeclared capability and is rejected by the category enum.

checks.description: The artifact content hash matches the embedded manifest.
